status_semantics: CLOSED_SOURCE means implemented with executable repository tests but does not itself grant E4 or external authority. BLOCKED_* rows have no remaining repository-only change that can manufacture the required fact. OPEN is reserved for concrete repository implementation work.

gaps.title: Inert fixture and exact historical object acknowledgement
gaps.close_criteria: Current source contains no key-shaped test sentinel; every acknowledged historical private-key marker is bound to exact path, marker digest and whole Git blob identity, while changed blobs fail.

gaps.title: G10 prose compatibility and typed controls
gaps.close_criteria: Legacy machine-state assertions and typed fail-closed validation controls agree without promoting external evidence.

gaps.title: Reverse tracked-source ownership and plugin registration
gaps.close_criteria: The flattened registry owns every tracked file in declared source roots, rejects orphans/ambiguity/escape/linking, and includes the Agent OS plugin.

gaps.title: Bounded calls and conservative uncertainty
gaps.close_criteria: Duplicate waits, worker count and receipt count are bounded; post-dispatch mutation errors/timeouts and terminal audit loss never become retry-safe failure, and late completion cannot overwrite the retained receipt.

gaps.title: Atomic current-consent memory and bounded retention
gaps.close_criteria: Consent/write/read/export/revoke are serialized, narrowing consent deletes removed classes, expiry does not resurrect data, collisions/capacity fail, and diagnostics are bounded without blocking deletion.

gaps.title: Production implementations behind provider/infrastructure gates
gaps.close_criteria: Implement durable identity/revocation and capability recovery, KMS/attestation interfaces, production model/realtime/OAuth adapters, Android PCM-to-ASR, asymmetric Skill verification plus sandbox, and encrypted persistent Memory. Deployed credentials, authorities and physical/provider evidence remain separate BLOCKED_EXTERNAL rows.

gaps.title: Full semantic module handoff and cross-language contracts
gaps.close_criteria: All 26 flattened modules have validated responsibility/API/state/failure/configuration/migration/operations/test/platform/evidence dimensions; Dart and Python consume one canonical JSON vector set and reject non-string keys/non-finite numbers; the mobile fail-closed startup surface exposes no action control.

gaps.title: Adopt reviewed candidate into authoritative main without bypass
evidence_required: successful non-empty seven-context exact-head run and content-verified artifact for the final unchanged source
eligible independent latest-head approval with all review conversations resolved
API readback of the complete canonical main protection contract
authorized adoption of the stacked source into main followed by regenerated exact-head evidence
gaps.unblock_condition: Repository administrators and an eligible independent reviewer complete and verify every required action without administrator bypass or self-merge. Any source/base movement requires new CI, artifact and review binding.

gaps.title: Authenticated product release oracle
gaps.close_criteria: Product mode invokes the trusted current-time G10 validator with an out-of-band registry pin and exact repository/commit/tree binding; all twelve authority-owned gaps, issuer classes, accepted review-set integrity and closure are required, while repository-authored status strings and booleans have no release authority.

gaps.title: Physical trace acquisition-order and recovery integrity
gaps.close_criteria: The evaluator preserves raw acquisition order, rejects timestamp regression and incomplete/non-contiguous capture sequences, digests the raw order, groups packet loss by side/generation, enforces production sample floors, and requires every declared fault to be injected, observed and recovered.
